definitions.gloss: good fight; putting up a good fight
definitions.explanation: fighting well or performing admirably, especially against a stronger opponent or in difficult circumstances

examples.japanese: {善戦|ぜんせん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: We put up a good fight but lost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{格上|かくうえ}→格上：07405_kakuue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{善戦|ぜんせん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They put up a good fight against a superior opponent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{善戦|ぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: The rookie team's strong performance became a talking point.

notes:
{善戦|ぜんせん} describes fighting well or performing admirably, often despite not winning.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{善|ぜん}→善：00465_zen⟧: Good, virtuous
- ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧: Battle, fight

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {善戦|ぜんせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to put up a good fight)
- {善戦|ぜんせん}むなしく (despite putting up a good fight)
- {善戦|ぜんせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{称|たた}える→称える：13751_tataeru⟧ (to praise someone's good fight)

USAGE:
- Often used when the result was a loss but the performance was praiseworthy
- Common in sports commentary
- Implies the fight was respectable even if unsuccessful

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧ (hard struggle - more emphasis on effort)
- ⟦{健闘|けんとう}→健闘：15326_kentou⟧ (good fight - nearly synonymous)
- ⟦{惜敗|せきはい}→惜敗：07904_sekihai⟧ (narrow defeat - focus on close loss)
- ⟦{接戦|せっせん}→接戦：08176_sessen⟧ (close game - focus on competitiveness)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in sports and competition contexts.
